claim: In the matching retail DLL, the referee-sound path is closed as two directly connected methods. MatchMisc.PlayRefereeSE (0x06004971) is a static one-parameter method named seid with an exact 87-byte body. Its only pre-dispatch suppression path requires non-null MatchMain, raw isFastForwardMatch nonzero, Fade.IsFadeFinish() true, and unsigned MchFrameCnt % 20 nonzero; otherwise it reaches dispatch, requires MatchSEPlayer.inst non-null, and calls MatchSEPlayer.PlayRefereeSE(seid) unchanged. MatchSEPlayer.PlayRefereeSE (0x06005278) is an instance one-parameter method named seid with an exact 77-byte body. It returns when seid is 109 or greater, resolves RefereeMan.GetInst().GetRefereeObj() and requires that object to convert true, returns when seid is negative, then requires rfs_se_wait_list[seid] to be zero. On the accepted path it stores raw 2 into rfs_se_wait_list[seid] and calls the already-canonical Menu_SoundManager.Play_MatchSE(seid,1.0f). FACT-0063 closes the shared positive-value wait-list decrement loop.
